verdict.rationale: Granola has an AI Chat that could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Granola as an MCP server that external AI tools connect to, which is the opposite role. Chat's built-in email, Slack and Calendar actions are first-party integrations, not user-pluggable MCP servers, so nothing shows users can add MCP servers to Granola.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
